messages:
marissa: Heads-up: Vendor 'CrimsonProbe' requested an external assessment next week. Scope ask: staging + a curated subset of production API routes, KMS-encrypted artifacts, and temporary console read-only sessions for assessors. They want log exports and a short retest window.

devin: What access methods do they need? Console SSO, API keys, or IP-based downloads? We should avoid giving console write perms.

marissa: They want SSO console read-only for 90 minutes to validate session-based auth flows. Assessors will be using Burp, wfuzz, and a custom lambda fuzzer. Main contact: samir@crimsonprobe.io.

omar: RBAC approach: create an ephemeral role via IdP with sessionDuration 90m, scope limited to resources tagged pt:crimson=true. No write permissions, no role chaining. We'll put a ticket with the exact policy diff and a rollback that revokes the role if anything odd appears.

riley: Audit logs: we can provide a compressed CSV of auth events (user, action, resource, ip, timestamp) and the app-level audit trail (request_id, endpoint, status, user_agent). We need to scrub PII and redact email addresses. How long a window do they need?

marissa: They asked for 30 days of context around the test run. Fine to give 7d around the engagement plus 30d for any findings. Confirm with them.

kate: KMS constraints: no direct KMS key handover. Plan: generate a per-engagement data-encryption-key (DEK), wrap it under alias/pt-crimson-2026, and create a KMS Grant scoped to the ephemeral principal. Use EncryptionContext containing pt-id:crimson-2026. We'll retire grants at end of engagement and rotate the DEK. Also prepare ListGrants audit exports.

omar: Can you add the exact aws cli snippets to the runbook? We should also provide presigned s3 links for artifact pulls so they don't need broad S3 perms.

kate: Sure. Example presign: 

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt/crimson/pack-2026-04-02.tar.gz --expires-in 7200
```

KMS grant (pseudo):

```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-crimson-2026 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-crimson-assessor --operations Encrypt Decrypt --constraints '{"EncryptionContextSubset":{"pt-id":"crimson-2026"}}'
```

riley: For the audit export CSV I'll prepare headers and a small sample file. Also will include field definitions and a note on hashed user ids for privacy.

pt-bot: scheduled: staging-maintenance-window at 2026-04-02T01:00Z (3h). Please confirm RBAC rollout timing.

marissa: Let's apply RBAC and provision grants during that maintenance window to contain scope. No prod changes.

devin: Retest timing: vendor wants 24-48h quick retest plus a 7-day follow-up. Proposal: quick retest 2026-04-03 13:00-16:00 UTC, follow-up 2026-04-10 09:00-11:00 UTC. Approvals?

omar: Infra OK. Pre-run checklist needs: snapshot logs, lock CI deploys for 4h, disable auto-rolls, and mute noisy alerts for assessor IP CIDR. I'll add the checklist to ENGSEC ticket.

kate: After retest, retire KMS grants and rotate DEK. Export ListRetireGrant logs for the evidence package. Also include KMS CloudWatch metric slice for key usage during engagement.

riley: SIEM/alerts: we'll suppress matching events for assessor IPs and include an allowlist in the alert mute rule. Make sure suppression doesn't disable critical incident escalations.

marissa: Action items: 
- devin: create RBAC change ticket with policy diff and rollback (due today)
- kate: write KMS DEK + grant runbook + cli examples (due tomorrow)
- riley: audit export query + CSV template + privacy notes (due tomorrow)
- omar: infra pre-run checklist & mute plan (due EOD)
- marissa: vendor intake (assessor IPs & SSO principals) and confirm retest slots (today)

devin: Opening ENGSEC-2208 and tagging legal for the NDA addendum. I'll paste the policy diff once I have it.

marissa: I'll confirm samir about the log window and whether they need the UI time. Will post assessor IP ranges when available.

omar: Reminder: limit ephemeral role actions to sts:AssumeRole, s3:GetObject (evidence bucket), logs:DescribeLogStreams, kms:Decrypt constrained by EncryptionContext. Keep perms minimal.

riley: tagging with #pen-test-intake and #audit-exports for visibility.

devin: Loop closed for now. Will update ticket with RBAC diff and timeline.

marissa: Thanks team. Reopen thread if CrimsonProbe requests console session extension.
